messages.subject: Project Tempest - restructuring term sheet
messages.htmlBody:
Gavin,

Following the standstill, here is where we have landed on the commercial shape for the restructuring term sheet:

- New £8m super-senior facility from Sterling, ranking ahead of A and B under an amended ICA;
- £4m shareholder contribution from Wexford (£2m equity + £2m subordinated loan);
- Facility A maturity extended to 30 June 2028; margins to 4.75% (A) and 4.50% (B); super-senior at 6.50% cash plus 2.00% PIK;
- Covenants reset: leverage opening at 5.00x stepping to 3.00x by Dec-26; minimum liquidity £2.5m tested weekly; equity cure up to twice a year.

If Sterling credit is comfortable in principle we'd like to sign the term sheet by 19 December per the milestone.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Tempest - restructuring term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Credit has reviewed. We're supportive of the overall package. Two points: we want the super-senior arrangement fee at 2.00% and the amendment fee at 0.50% of A+B commitments; and we'd like a 50% excess cashflow sweep applied first to the super-senior. Pricing and the covenant steps as you set out are agreed.

On that basis we can sign the term sheet by 19 December. Pemberton Rowe will lead documentation from our side.

Gavin

Gavin Ross | Director, Restructuring & Recoveries | Sterling Commercial Bank plc
